facts.fact: Consultant Oumar Camara and ANSSI's alert centre director say Guinea has had a law on cybersecurity and personal data protection since 2016, mainly oriented to cybercrime.
facts.system: 2016 law on cybersecurity and personal data protection

facts.fact: The document says ANSSI held a consultation workshop on draft legal texts on cybersecurity and cybercrime, prepared with SOCSLAWYERS on the ministry's instruction, to update the 2016 framework.
